description: This file defines an abstract class YAxisRenderer that handles the rendering logic for the Y-axis in charting components, including scale calculations and tick mark settings.

classes.name: YAxisRenderer
classes.description: Abstract class for rendering Y axes, providing methods for axis scaling and tick calculations.

methods.name: FineTuneYAxis
methods.description: Calculates and adjusts the Y-axis scale, tick marks, and minor divisions based on data range.

methods.name: GetDefaultTickLabelsFormat
methods.description: Returns default format string for Y-axis tick labels.
